polishes.description: Trippin' on a Hole in a Paper Heart is a sparkling scattered holo with baby blue, fiery red, emerald green, and silver glitters. Mixed effect reads slightly green from a distance.Part of the Grunge Collection; dreary shades with hints of twinkly metamorphosis, named after mainstays in 90s grunge.My photos (tattooed hand with stars) use 2 coats + Afterparty topcoat.Named after the song Trippin' on a Hole in a Paper Heart by Stone Temple Pilots.additional swatches by Erica @lacquer.and.light | Mona @phdidmynails | Lavenie @lacquer.me.up | Madison @mg_lacquer5 | Reese @torqueandtopcoats | Chris @plantnerdbroom

polishes.name: What's My Age Again?
polishes.description: What's My Age Again? is a yellow glitter shimmer that shifts blue depending on the light.Part of Collection 182; bright, sassy shades named after hits by the pop punk powerhouses.My photos (tattooed hand with stars) use 3 coats + Afterparty topcoat.Named after the song What's My Age Again? by blink-182.additional swatches by Mona @phdidmynails | Reese @torqueandtopcoats | Em @lizardsnlacquer

polishes.name: Your Heart Is a Muscle the Size of Your Fist
polishes.description: Your Heart Is a Muscle the Size of Your Fist is a lavender jelly with a strong shimmer that shifts from teal to pink depending on the light.Part of the Folk Punk collection; bold, earthy shimmers named after crusty folk punk standouts.My photos (tattooed hand with stars) use 2 coats + Afterparty topcoat.Named after the song Your Heart Is a Muscle the Size of Your Fist by Pat the Bunny.additional swatches by Reese @torqueandtopcoats | Em @lizardsnlacquer | Jeremy @aculednails | Mona @phdidmynails | Chris @plantnerdbroom
